audience: Readers exploring a fictional independent publication
primary_task: Read a story and find its related issue
visual_direction: Text-led editorial hierarchy with a compact masthead and calm reading pages
locked_decisions: Preserve the supplied monochrome brand; colour is not added merely to avoid a stereotype.

pages.purpose: Discover the current issue and selected stories
Read a complete article and navigate references

fonts.family: System stack for the example only
fonts.source: Operating system fonts; no files bundled

acceptance.requirement: A visitor can open and read the complete story using keyboard navigation.
Essential text remains accessible at narrow widths and 200% zoom.
The rendered hierarchy respects the approved direction and real content.
